theorems.name: Sign-conjugate centered reduction and quotient reversal
postconditions: the two exact quotients are negatives of each other

theorems.name: Centered-addition closure with exact one-correction carry
theorems.formula: R(R(a)+R(b)) = centered_mod(a+b), with correction coefficient in {-1,0,1}
theorems.domain: all int16_t x int16_t input pairs
preconditions: a and b are unrestricted int16_t
postconditions: R(R(a)+R(b)) equals an independent centered-modulo oracle for a+b
the second reduction is exactly s-c*q for c in {-1,0,1}
the result is congruent to a+b modulo q
theorems.expected_failure_control: false no-wrap claim on the positive-correction branch
